text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 30 by September 1st, 2025, be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit Guarantee Statement2.High school graduate with good performance.3.For students from non-English speaking countries, New TOEFL should be above 80 and IELTS should be above 6.0; for students whose high school classes were taught in English, you need to provide a English teaching proof; there is no requirements for students from English-speaking countries.
